Name: Skill Mastery Prestige
Author: TimBukTw0
Description:
[b]Skill Mastery Prestige [/b]adds a skill prestiging system to Stardew Valley, giving veteran farmers a new layer of progression beyond Level 10 and Mastery.
Once you've claimed a skill’s star in the Mastery Cave, you can prestige it. This resets the skill back to level 0 in exchange for a Prestige Point and the chance to climb again. XP earned for that skill will no longer contribute to the Mastery Counter until you reach level 10 again.
Each prestige allows you to unlock all professions on the skill tree, and doing so grants small buffs to truly prove your mastery of the skill.

[line]
[b]Prestige Points[/b]
Earn Prestige Points by prestiging skills and spend them in the Prestige Menu to permanently unlock professions outside the normal level-up system. Professions remain organized into two branches per skill, with tier-1 unlocks opening the path to their tier-2 professions.
Unlocking all professions at a level cap rewards passive stat buffs:
[list]
[*]+1 stat when both level-5 professions are unlocked[/*]
[*]+2 additional stats when all four level-10 professions are unlocked[/*]
[/list][b]Faster Leveling[/b]
Unspent Prestige Points also speed up leveling, granting bonus XP and Mastery XP.
[b]
Optional Difficulty Scaling[/b]
Looking for an extra challenge? Enable the XP Difficulty option to increase the XP required to level up with each prestige, turning every new run into a true test of dedication.

[b]Mastery Cave Integration[/b]
With default settings, you must visit the Mastery Cave to initiate a prestige (via a button in the mastery menu or a keybind), then sleep to confirm your choice. When you wake the next morning, your skill is reset and your Prestige Point awaits you back at the cave.

[b]Fully Configurable[/b]
Everything can be customized through Generic Mod Config Menu, including keybinds, bonus rates, difficulty scaling, and whether the cave and sleep requirements are enforced.

[b]Community Translations
[/b]Want to play in your language? The mod includes the i18n json system for ease of translation.

[b]Modded Skill Support[/b]
Using custom skills from other mods? Skill Mastery Prestige fully supports modded skills through SpaceCore!
Confirmed to function with the following mods:[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14073]Binning Skill[/url],[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22681] YACS - Yet Another Cooking Skill[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28103]Spacecore Luck Skill[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14142]Socializing Skill[/url].
